WITH line AS (
  SELECT pv.product_sku AS product_sku, pv.record_path AS record_path,
         pv.product_name AS product_name, LOWER(pv.properties) AS props
  FROM product_variants pv
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pv.brand)) = 'carhartt'
    AND LOWER(pv.product_name) LIKE '%3ey-11k%'
),
flags AS (
  SELECT l.product_sku, l.record_path, l.product_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN (LOWER(pvp.property_key) LIKE '%color%' AND LOWER(pvp.property_value_text) LIKE '%blue%')
                  OR l.props LIKE '%blue%' OR LOWER(l.product_name) LIKE '%blue%'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_color,
    MAX(CASE WHEN (LOWER(pvp.property_key) LIKE '%size%' AND LOWER(TRIM(pvp.property_value_text)) = 'xs')
                  OR l.props LIKE '%"xs"%' OR l.props LIKE '%: xs%' OR LOWER(l.product_name) LIKE '% xs %' OR LOWER(l.product_name) LIKE '% xs'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_size,
    MAX(CASE WHEN (LOWER(pvp.property_key) LIKE '%fit%' AND LOWER(pvp.property_value_text) LIKE '%women%')
                  OR l.props LIKE '%women%' OR LOWER(l.product_name) LIKE '%women%'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_fit
  FROM line l
  LEFT JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = l.product_sku
  GROUP BY l.product_sku, l.record_path, l.product_name
),
scored AS (
  SELECT product_sku, record_path, product_name, has_color, has_size, has_fit,
         (has_color * has_size * has_fit) AS extra_holds
  FROM flags
),
picked AS (
  SELECT * FROM scored ORDER BY extra_holds DESC, product_sku ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM line) AS checked_count,
  (SELECT product_sku FROM picked) AS product_sku,
  (SELECT record_path FROM picked) AS record_path,
  (SELECT product_name FROM picked) AS product_name,
  COALESCE((SELECT has_color FROM picked), 0) AS has_color,
  COALESCE((SELECT has_size FROM picked), 0) AS has_size,
  COALESCE((SELECT has_fit FROM picked), 0) AS has_fit,
  COALESCE((SELECT extra_holds FROM picked), 0) AS extra_holds;
